_about: Demo product information (Legal Metrology declarations, specifications, highlights) by product title, and the product information each demo category requires. Used by seed --demo and by python -m scripts.apply_demo_details for an already-seeded database. All names, addresses and licence numbers are made-up demo values.

details.manufacturer: Kumbakonam Brew Coffee Works (demo), 14 Big Street, Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu 612001
details.shelf_life: 9 months from the date of packing
details.ingredients: Roasted and ground coffee (80%), roasted chicory (20%).
details.directions: Add 3 teaspoons to the upper chamber of a South Indian filter, pour 150 ml of boiling water and leave for 15 minutes. Mix the decoction with hot milk and sugar to taste.
details.safety_info: Store in an airtight container away from moisture and sunlight. Close the pack tightly after use.
details.legal_disclaimer: Actual product packaging and materials may contain more information than shown here. Read the label before use.

highlights: Classic Kumbakonam degree coffee: 80% Peaberry and Plantation A beans with 20% chicory
Roasted in small batches and ground fine for the South Indian filter
Thick, aromatic decoction that stays strong with milk
Packed in a resealable aroma-lock pouch
Brews about 60 cups
